args: Run the /self-improve weekly routine across all projects with new completed work, retros, outcomes, or decisions since the last /self-improve pass (or for the current repository when running standalone). Record 1-occurrence candidates in project memory, and for any confirmed pattern (2+ independent occurrences for general taste/domain conventions, 3+ for process/skill changes), drop a proposed root task or report the evidence-backed proposal for human approval. Never edit rules or skills unattended.
description: Every Monday at 9:00 AM, runs /self-improve across active projects to distill recurring taste, assumption, retro, and outcome patterns into proposed rules or lore for human approval.
